entities.name: Hemorrhoidectomy retention risk
observations: A large anorectal-surgery study reported 21.9% urinary retention after hemorrhoidectomy and identified greater hemorrhoid resection extent as an independent risk factor; postoperative analgesic need was also associated. PMID:16552523.
A 2024 nested case-control study found severe postoperative pain (VAS >6) independently predicted urinary retention after benign anorectal surgery. PMID:39103817.

entities.name: Spinal anesthesia retention comparison
observations: A randomized hemorrhoidectomy/anal-fistula trial found postoperative urinary retention in 0% with ultra-low-dose spinal anesthesia versus 3.1% with perineal block; the difference was not significant. PMID:37247818.
